description:
BOX Property Management is pleased to present this well-maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home offering an easy-care lifestyle in a convenient Butler location.

Fresh, bright and practical, the home has been designed with low-maintenance living in mind. Recently painted throughout in a neutral colour palette, the property features wood-look vinyl plank flooring through the main living areas, a functional open-plan layout and a private outdoor entertaining space.

The master bedroom includes carpeted flooring, his-and-hers walk-in robes and a private ensuite, while the two additional bedrooms include built-in robes and are positioned close to the family bathroom.

At the heart of the home is a practical kitchen complete with stainless steel appliances, rangehood, built-in pantry, fridge recess and ample bench space, flowing directly into the light-filled living and dining area.

Outside, the fully paved split-level entertaining area offers a great low-maintenance space for relaxing or enjoying a weekend BBQ.

PROPERTY FEATURES
3 bedrooms
2 bathrooms
Spacious master bedroom with his-and-hers walk-in robes
Ensuite to master
Built-in robes to minor bedrooms
Family bathroom with shower and bath
Open-plan living and dining
Functional kitchen with stainless steel appliances
Gas cooking and rangehood
Built-in pantry and fridge recess
Ample kitchen bench and storage space
Recently painted throughout
Wood-look vinyl plank flooring to main living areas
Reverse-cycle split-system air conditioning
Separate laundry with linen storage
Fully paved low-maintenance outdoor entertaining area
Double remote carport
Fibre optic internet connection
Additional TV and power points
Low-maintenance front gardens
**Property is Leased UNFURNISHED**

LOCATION HIGHLIGHTS

Positioned in a convenient pocket of Butler, the home offers easy access to everything needed for day-to-day living.

Close to:

Butler Train Station
Butler Central shopping precinct
Butler Primary School
Brampton Lake and surrounding parklands
Brighton café and retail precinct
Local shops, schools and childcare
Freeway access and major transport links

AVAILABLE 1st week of October 2026

PETS CONSIDERED


HOW TO VIEW THIS PROPERTY
Arranging an inspection is easy. Simply click the “Make an Enquiry” or “Email Agent” button on the rental property listing and enter your details. Our system will then send you an email requesting that you register your details so you can receive inspection updates and register your enquiry.

You can then choose to join an existing inspection time or contact the agent to arrange a new time. Once registered, you’ll receive a confirmation email. Please follow the prompts within the email to confirm your attendance at the inspection.
All Applications are to be made via Tenantoptions.com.au

PLEASE NOTE: If you do not register to attend we can't notify you of any changes or cancellations to open. Opens are subject to cancellation if no one is registered to attend.
